units.source_text: 然后，千重子躲到后面二楼自己的寝室里，欣赏父亲带去嵯峨尼姑庵的保罗·克利和夏加尔的画集。

en.t: Then Chieko withdrew to her own bedroom on the second floor at the back and looked through the art books of Paul Klee and Chagall that her father had taken to the nunnery in Saga.
After a while, Chieko fell asleep.

units.source_text: 不一会儿，她就被噩梦魇住，发出“啊！啊！”的声音，醒了。

en.t: Before long, she was oppressed by a nightmare, cried out, “Ah! Ah!” and woke up.
